besluite.fout: 'Reën val nie ... dieselfde hoeveelheid nie' is a wooden construction with an object-like amount hanging off an intransitive verb.
besluite.rede: The existential 'daar val ... ewe veel reën' is the natural Afrikaans form and says exactly the same.
'een enkele jaar' is acceptable Afrikaans and its emphasis carries the contrast with 'n hele jaar' in the next sentences, so the cut loses something for no clear gain.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('n Mens kan meet / die maat is).
besluite.rede: AWS 2017 requires the comma here and nothing else changes.

besluite.fout: ''n millimeter hoog met water bedek' is stiff and makes the reader stumble.
besluite.rede: 'met 'n millimeter water bedek' is the natural phrasing, means the same depth, and leaves the protected ''n plat oppervlak' untouched.

besluite.fout: 'saam' is loose about what is done with the millimetres.
besluite.rede: 'bymekaargetel' states the adding-up plainly for a Grade 6 reader without changing the claim.

besluite.fout: 'daardie plek' points back to a place the block never names.
besluite.rede: 'op 'n plek' removes the dangling reference and keeps the meaning.
Only two sentences open with 'Die kaart', the repetition is clear for a Grade 6 reader, and 'Dit' is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: After 'twee soorte' a countable noun normally takes the plural in Afrikaans.
besluite.rede: 'Twee soorte kaarte' is the expected form in a block heading and changes nothing else.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb (Temperatuurkaarte wys / 'n reënvalkaart wys).
besluite.rede: AWS 2017 requires the comma here; the change does not overlap change 10.

besluite.fout: 'hoeveel reën val' without 'daar' reads thin in this clause.
besluite.rede: The existential 'daar' is the natural Afrikaans form here and the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'oplees' means to read aloud, so the verb is wrong, and 'sy eie sleutel' could point to the shade instead of the map.
besluite.rede: The proposal names the right action and makes clear it is each map's own key, with no new fact.

besluite.fout: 'warm nie ook nat beteken nie' is compressed and a young reader can take it as 'warm places are not wet', which the Amazon in the same block contradicts.
besluite.rede: 'nie noodwendig nat is nie' says exactly what 'beteken nie' implies logically, so the intended meaning is kept and made unambiguous.

besluite.fout: One reads values off a map, not a country; 'Lees Suid-Afrika af' is unidiomatic.
besluite.rede: 'Kyk na Suid-Afrika self op die reënvalkaart' is natural, and the next sentence's 'Volgens die sleutel' still carries the map reading.

besluite.fout: 'staan in 'n donkerder skakering' is an unidiomatic way to say a map area is shaded darker.
besluite.rede: 'het 'n donkerder skakering as' is the plain natural form with the same comparison.

besluite.fout: The 'en ... gemeet word' clause is loosely joined, so what is measured in millimetres is unclear.
besluite.rede: This is a glossary definition, so a rewording beyond a plain spelling or grammar fix belongs to the writer for every lesson at once.
